title: Redis in Action
blurb: Redis from zero to production: data structures, caching, persistence and replication, queues, locks, search, a social feed, memory tuning, scaling, Lua scripting, streams, Cluster, vector search and the caching and rate-limiting patterns interviews ask about - every idea with a runnable simulation.
sources: Josiah L. Carlson, Redis in Action (Manning, 2013), ch. 1-11
Redis documentation (redis.io/docs): data types, persistence, replication, Sentinel, Cluster specification, streams, ACLs, client-side caching, eviction, programmability, vector search
